t: Bosch multi-tool blade set with colour-coding for easy blade identification. Suitable for softwood, hardwood, chipboard, laminate, parquet, soft plastics, sheet metals up to 1mm, non-ferrous profiles, hardened metal and putty. Includes a durable carbide blade for metals, a hardwood blade with sharp Japanese tooth design, and bi-metal blades in 32mm and 65mm widths for wood and metal. Also features a segment blade with small tooth geometry for non-hardened metals and plunge blade with Curved-Tec rounded edges for clean, controlled cuts. Compatible with Starlock, Starlock Plus, Starlock Max and OIS systems, fitting all common multi-tools. Supplied with storage case.
